description: Shell script implementing IPv4-in-IPv6 tunnel backend functions, including setup, teardown, and configuration initialization for different tunnel types (map-e, map-t, lw4o6).

methods.name: proto_map_setup
methods.description: Sets up IPv4-in-IPv6 tunnel based on configuration parameters, handling different tunnel types and configuring routing and firewall rules.

methods.name: proto_map_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the configured tunnel, removing routes and cleaning up temporary files.

methods.name: proto_map_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for the map protocol, defining required parameters.
